title: Whether a '(hostile)'-tagged creature requires combat or can simply be walked past is inconsistent and only revealed by easy-to-miss flavor text ('will let you pass if you let it be' vs. 'attacks on sight'); the menu itself looks identical either way, offering 'attack' alongside ordinary movement with no other cue.
where: Twin Stones vs. Charcoal Ring (Vale of Ash)/room description text
